steer_followups.flicker_root_cause: PINNED in code: WorldEngine.tsx:267 animTick setState every 300ms + PixiWorldCanvas.tsx:616 useEffect(draw) with no dep array -> draw() destroys/recreates the ENTIRE tile Graphics (~900 tiles) + door Text labels on every render (~3.3x/s forever, plus NPC tick 650ms and every step). Missed frames show canvas bg #0a1a0a = flicker. Fix design: cache the static tile+label layer in a ref keyed by (map id/size, tile px) — it is drawn in world coords and does not depend on camera or animTick; only dynamic drawables rebuild per draw.
steer_followups.white_box_root_cause: PINNED: human atlases (src/assets/human-characters/in-game-sheets/*) have OPAQUE light-grey cell backgrounds (e.g. hex atlas corners (223,223,223,255)); pixiSheet.ts sheetCellTexture/sheetCellTextureXY crop raw cells with no keying. Creature cuts are transparent (alpha 0 corners) so a corner-guarded edge flood-fill key in the two pixiSheet loaders fixes humans and no-ops creatures. One fix location.
steer_followups.battle_black_bars: NOT yet pinned. Path battle = WorldEngine inline (SYS_BATTLE header black bar, dark slate arena, black bottom panel; root w-screen h-screen). Intro/title uses a 1200x1500 portrait stage letterboxed on landscape (LockedStage.tsx: scaleStage + .locked-stage-frame sides = stage background #050810 near-black). Needs phone-aspect (e.g. 390x844 / 360x740) captures of the actual battle to separate by-design bars from stage-frame bleed before changing code.
steer_followups.webgl_chunk: Pixi WebGLRenderer is a lazy dynamic import; a failed fetch = permanent black world, HUD alive, no retry/error surface (seen nav11/nav13 when the python static server dropped the chunk; node server fixed serving). Worth a bootstrap retry/error note in the same fix pass.
